selectedIdea.rationale: Explain the central distinction through the available evidence.

synthesis.content:
### Evidence

Congress passed the amendment on March 23, 1971, and it was ratified on July 1, 1971.

The amendment bars both federal and state governments from denying or limiting US citizens' voting rights because of age when the citizens are at least 18.

Congress can enforce the amendment through appropriate legislation.
